name: QIDI ASA @BBL A1
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 120 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed lowered to 10.8 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 120 mm/s rating.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page parameter image: nozzle 240-280 C, bed 100-110 C, fan 0-60 %, 1.75 +/-0.02 mm. Comparison guide: 240-260 C, bed 80-110 C, 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, HDT 93 C. Older wiki table: 260-280 C, bed 100-110 C, chamber 50 C, density 1.07, annealing 80-90 C 6-12 h. Chamber and density from older wiki table.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/qidi-asa-filament
